profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at LogicGate

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Dev Lead
positions.description:
- Lead front-end development for product vertical team, including owning technical planning and writing design documents; collaborating with product managers, designers, QA, and non-technical stakeholders; and managing ticket creation, prioritization, and distribution for a team of 6 engineers. 
- Lead Web Accessibility initiative, resulting in new accessibility processes for design annotations, assistive device product requirements, and frontend development acceptance criteria.
- Launch mission critical Automated Evidence Collection feature resulting in over $140K of new annual recurring revenue in the first 4 months of release. 
- Manage career development, enable professional growth, and provide formal and informal feedback for 3 engineers as mentees and 1 engineer as a direct report.

TECH: Java, TypeScript, Angular, Neo4j, Spring, AWS, Postman, Terraform, Git, Agile

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Help lead migration of major front-end JavaScript library dependency (Google Blockly), including scoping technical requirements, managing implementation, and collaborating with external Google stakeholders
- Collaborated with product managers, designers, and engineering managers to build, test, debug, and maintain API and UI for full stack web application.
- Participated in an engineering architecture working group to plan and document system architecture changes for the long term sustainability of our code base; mapped system design decisions onto initiatives, epics, and tickets to be prioritized based on business needs.

TECH: Python, Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, React, AWS, Git, Agile
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Ruby on Rails · JavaScript · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with product management, design, QA, and non-technical stakeholders to design, implement, test and maintain single page web application
- Led development of new Home Screen feature which yielded a 68% adoption rate in the first month of release.

TECH: Java, TypeScript, Angular, Neo4j, Spring, AWS, Postman, Terraform, Git, Agile

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the team-wide adoption of Redux-Sagas, Flow, and Sequelize to operationalize programming and documentation best practices.
- Worked on a greenfield V2 workforce management application to replace existing service in order to improve user flows and increase self-service model. 


TECH: MySQL, Node.js, JavaScript, React, Redux, Git, AWS, Postman, Flow
positions.insights: Skills: Redux.js · Node.js · MySQL · JavaScript · React.js

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
At Inquiry Partners, I led and implemented a streamline process for website user flow from top of funnel to registration which resulted in a 40% increase in monthly registration. I also got to collaborate with an amazing team of Senior Leadership on a product that expands traditional educational norms toward an innovative and inquiry-based approach. 

Inquiry Partners is a global professional development company dedicated to providing training, support and digital measurement tools to countries, districts, schools and individual teachers interested in implementing inquiry-based instruction. We've initiated partnerships with global teacher networks and worked with dozens of schools around the world, delivering in-person and interactive online workshops. 

www.inquirypartners.com

positions.title: Lead Instructor
positions.description:
At Codeverse, I took my degrees in math and physics and my classroom experience to create more impactful lesson plans, for example introducing formative assessments to collect student data and increase student learning outcomes.

As a lead instructor I delegated roles, facilitated whole group discussions, and owned organizational tasks for the team. 

Codeverse® is the world's first fully interactive coding school and educational tech platform that teaches kids to code.

positions.title: Science Instructor
positions.description: As a science instructor, I developed and implemented a standards-aligned physics curriculum driven by student data. I created a quarterly assessment to collect student data that was analyzed to make major decision regarding network-wide 9th grade science curriculum.

positions.title: Math and Science Resource Specialist
positions.description: As a resource specialist I coached and supported incoming Teach for America Corps members during the summer teacher training program. My role was to support corps members by demonstrating lessons,  and providing data-driven feedback and evaluations through observations.

positions.title: 2015 Chicago/NWI Corps Member
positions.description: As a 2015 corps member I was a 10th grade Geometry teacher for the Noble Network of Charter Schools

positions.title: Geometry Teacher at Muchin College Prep
positions.description:
As a math instructor I created and implemented a curriculum that utilized student data to deliver individualized instruction. I had the honor of working with over 300 students at one of the top performing charter schools in the greater Chicago area. 

Outside of my classroom I coached robotics and co-facilitated an intro to programming and electronics course. I also helped students organize and create the school's first Filipino Club, and supported students in hosting the first school-wide event for the Asian American and Pacific Islander history month.

company.name: The Noble Network of Charter Schools

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant / Tutorial Instructor - Physics Education Group
positions.description:
The University of Washington's education group focuses on producing inquiry-based physics curriculum.  

As a research assistant I analyzed student data utilized in high schools developed by the Physics Education Group to re-design existing curriculum. 

As a tutorial instructor utilized inquiry-style instruction using resources development the Physics Education Group.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant - Axion Dark Matter Experiment
positions.description: As a research assistant I designed, built and maintained specialized electronics for the Axion Dark Matter Experiment. The specialized electronics were used in research and data acquisition. Skills I used as a researcher include Audrino programming, java programming, Diptrace, machining, and soldering.

honors.title: President's Volunteer Service Award (Gold)
honors.description:

Your recognition inspires others to take positive action to change the world."
